error[ZBX-E0501]: not an image reference
  while  reading an image reference
  cause  the repository in 'Alpine:3.20' has an uppercase letter, which a
         repository never has
  ref    Alpine:3.20
  fix    write it as name[:tag]:   zbx pull alpine:3.20
         or with a registry:       zbx pull ghcr.io/owner/image:v1
  more   zbx explain E0501
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0501.html
